title: Act: Implement round Scheduler with injected Clock
summary: Add scheduler.go with Tick and Run
description: Scheduler iterates worlds, lists rounds and calls the lifecycle controller.
acceptance_criteria: Tick returns the first error but continues other rounds
Run ticks every Interval until ctx is done

steps.symbol: new: Clock, Controller, Scheduler, Tick, Run
steps.action: Define Clock, Controller, Lister{List(worldID)([]Round,error)}; Scheduler{Controller, Rounds Lister, Worlds func()([]string,error), Clock, Interval}. Tick(ctx): for each world and round, if Status==SCHEDULED and !Clock.Now().Before(StartsAt) call Open with zero OpenOptions; if Status==OPEN and !Clock.Now().Before(EndsAt) call Close; collect errors with errors.Join. Run(ctx): ticker of Interval (default 30s) calling Tick, logging errors with slog, returning on ctx.Done()
